scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && npm run test && npm run check:web && npm run check:client-contract && npm run clean-name
scripts.test: npm run test:cloudflare && npm run test:selfhost
scripts.build:web: node scripts/build-web.mjs && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts && vite build --config frontend/vite.admin.config.ts && vite build --config frontend/vite.login.config.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate:cloudflare && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate:cloudflare:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:cloudflare:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc
